item.title: The Silicon Shift: Hollywood Stakes Its Future on Generative AI
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Can generative AI rescue Hollywood's runaway production budgets? Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison believes silicon-driven workflows are the industry's biggest creative unlock since CGI.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Paramount Skydance is actively developing proprietary AI tooling designed to compress production timelines and reduce skyrocketing project budgets. [SPLIT] ⚡ Runaway inflation in filmmaking—such as scaling a $4 million classic like Terminator into a modern $70 million endeavor—is a primary operational target for automation. item.title: Compromised Compute: Nvidia Probe Exposes US AI Hardware Vulnerabilities
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A federal counterintelligence investigation into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang exposes a strategic vulnerability: how foreign intelligence targeting of private tech monopolies threatens Western military AI dominance.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Nvidia's Blackwell compute architecture directly underpins Western defense AI initiatives, elevating CEO security to a national security imperative. [SPLIT] ⚡ Information latency between intelligence agencies and executive leadership exacerbates supply chain counterespionage risks.
